newsitem.title: POLAND: Bytom sets issue price at PLN 27.
newsitem.headline: Bytom sets issue price at PLN 27.

text.p: The Polish garment maker Bytom SA set the price of its forthcoming 250,000-share issue at 27 zlotys per share, the company said in a statement.
The issue, which was cleared by the Polish Securities Commission in August, will increase the company's share capital by half from the present 500,000 shares.

The firm earlier said the shares would be offered ex-rights with the large-investor 150,000-share tranche scheduled from October 2 to October 4 and the small-investor tranche of 100,000 shares set for between October 2 and October 9.
Large investors can register for 5,000 to 150,000 shares.
The company plans to use 60 percent of the funds raised by the issue to boost its working capital.
The remaining 40 percent would be spent on upgrading the company's several production facilities.
